deadline.value: International applicants apply through OUAC by April 15 for Fall entry; documents are due one month later. Apply nine months ahead.
deadline.quote: International: Fall (September): April 15 | Application documents are due one month after the application deadline. | It is recommended that international applicants apply a minimum of 9 months in advance of the program’s start date.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test exists for engineering.

supervisor.value: You must secure a faculty advisor; a thesis supervisor is required for admission.
supervisor.quote: securing a Graduate Faculty Advisor is a crucial step, as a thesis supervisor is required for admission.

funding.value: All full-time PhD students are guaranteed funding; from Summer 2026 the minimum for international students is CAD 37,500 a year for 4 years.
funding.quote: The College of Engineering guarantees financial support to all full-time thesis-based MASc. and PhD students admitted to the program. | For students commencing their full-time PhD engineering studies in S26 or later, the minimum guaranteed stipend is $27,000 per year for 4 years for domestic students, and $37,500 per year for 4 years for international students.

entry_route.value: A master's in engineering (73%+) is normally required; direct entry from a bachelor's is rarely granted.
entry_route.quote: The minimum academic requirement for admission to the PhD program is normally a recognized Master's degree in engineering. | Direct admission to the PhD program from a Bachelor's program is rarely granted.

ielts_min.value: IELTS 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0.
ielts_min.quote: For IELTS tests, please note that the College of Engineering requires an overall score of 6.5 with no individual band less than 6.0.

english_waiver.value: A test is required if your degree is from a country whose first language is not English, so an English-medium Indian degree does not exempt you.
english_waiver.quote: if your university degree was acquired in a country where the first language is not English, you are required to submit a passing English language test (IELTS test) in support of your application.

notes: One PhD with eight fields: Biological, Biomedical, Computer, Engineering Systems & Computing, Environmental, Mechanical, Mechatronics and Water Resources Engineering.
name: PhD in Engineering
